Independent from the proof, exact symbolic and full-state enumerator gave 2223 assertions over 132 feasible rational cases. Finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The new claim is the exact nonexchangeable four-site Markov disease-screening optimizer including alternation under negative correlation, not the classical test-cost expression or generic Markov chain product identity. Full primary comparisons distinguish three plausible source classes: Hong--Scaglione 2008 restricts sensor queries to contiguous groups; Lendle--Hudgens--Qaqish 2011 assumes exchangeable clusters; Landolfi--Lall 2023 assumes global exchangeability. Targeted actual search did not identify the exact four-phase law. Remaining risk is possible historically equivalent group-testing calculations outside indexed or reviewed sources.

value.rationale: A natural public-health decision problem with ordered spatial correlations receives a complete finite minimal exact optimization; all four plausible laboratory partition structures are genuinely optimal in strict regions of parameter space. The transition from adjacent to alternating pooled pairs under sign reversal is operationally distinct and is explained by a general n-site fixed-size pool lemma. This is not merely a numerical calculation of a known table; it gives a reusable exact benchmark and a structural warning that contiguity assumptions can lose efficiency. Not a calibrated clinical recommendation.
